summary: Verified all 85 estimates after reading the complete markdown conversion, including all supplementary methods, tables and figure captions, and extracting all 16 PDF pages cited by estimate sources. Recorded statistics and counts match the printed values and the stated outcomes, arms and analyses. Outcome coding, timing, units, comparison types and uncertainty bases are consistent with the codebook. No missing eligible full-sample outcome or reported contrast was identified. Unprinted counts, unspecified dispersion types and unresolved robustness uncertainty are appropriately left null or marked unclear; full-process interaction terms, mediation, subgroups and process-only outcomes are appropriately excluded.
